defs.def: to come out of a dark, confined or hidden place （从隐蔽处或暗处）出现，浮现，露出

ex.s: proved with emerging lakesB. underestimated by scientists
ex.t: 被新出现的湖泊所证明 B. 被科学家低估

ex.s: Across the 320 submissions, a pattern of categories the researchers call a “nature language” began to emerge.
ex.t: 在320份提交材料中，一种被研究人员称为“自然语言”的类别模式开始显现。

ex.s: Meaning emerges through a process of social interaction, not of computation, interaction that shapes the content of the symbols in our heads.
ex.t: 意义通过社会互动的过程产生，而非计算过程——这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: Emerging research suggests that courses in lower-ranked universities, on average, scored higher on teaching than courses in higher-ranked universities. ____37____ The absence of teaching excellence from the rankings is surprising given the link between high-quality teaching and student success.
ex.t: 新兴研究表明，平均而言，排名较低大学的课程在教学方面的得分高于排名较高的大学。____37____ 考虑到高质量教学与学生成功之间的联系，排名中缺少教学质量这一点令人惊讶。

ex.s: Efforts to improve teaching at the university level have recently emerged.
ex.t: 大学层面改进教学的努力最近才出现。

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还激发了我内心想要在这个世界做出改变的愿望。

ex.s: Seconds later, our lizard emerged from its tank with its old skin flowing behind it.
ex.t: 几秒钟后我们的蜥蜴从箱子里钻了出来旧皮跟在身后飘动。

ex.s: It turns out that baby red-backed fairy wrens also emerge chirping like their moms.
ex.t: 结果发现，红背细尾鹩莺幼鸟孵化出来时也会像妈妈一样啁啾。

ex.s: Seeing an opening in the pupa, he realised that the butterfly was ready to emerge.
ex.t: 看到蛹上有一个开口，他意识到蝴蝶准备破茧而出了。

defs.def: to become known 事实、意见等

ex.s: It is no wonder that many, if not most, of China’s leading scholars and scientists emerged at Lianda, including the two Nobel Prize-winning physicists, Yang Zhenning and Li Zhengdao.
ex.t: 难怪中国许多——如果不是大多数——顶尖学者和科学家都出自联大，包括两位诺贝尔物理学奖得主杨振宁和李政道。

ex.s: From this, Impressionism emerged in France.
ex.t: 由此，印象派在法国应运而生。

ex.s: REFLECTING dimension emerge exhibition guarantee investment purchase recognition representative visual 1 The first principle for any art collector is to only what you love.
ex.t: 反思 维度 涌现 展览 担保 投资 购买 认可 代表 视觉 1 对于任何艺术品收藏家来说，首要原则就是只买自己真正喜爱的东西。

ex.s: Readers can get to know that Beethoven was a strong and pure man, and that despite all his sufferings, he never gave up and emerged as a conqueror.
ex.t: 读者可以了解到贝多芬是一个坚强而纯粹的人，尽管历经千辛万苦，他从未放弃，最终以征服者的姿态崛起。

defs.def: to start to exist; to appear or become known 露头；显现；显露
to survive a difficult situation or experience （从困境或苦难经历中）幸存下来，摆脱出来
